PF2D6E1.title: F2 normal degree-six even-terminal exclusion
PF2D6E1.scope: Assume the F2 terminal Cartier slice in the local rank-three Stein factor is normal. Terminal localization and the carrier/genus gates leave even exponents r=6,8,10. Exact implicitization proves that the paired rational quintics differ respectively by a conic, a line, and a constant. Orevkov's residue-normalized degree-six identity requires total local excess one. The r=10 saturation is a disjoint union of two four-node quintics, so its branch divisor is SNC and has excess zero. For r=8, the entire necessary locus is a reduced quartic field whose pair is uniformly A2+3A1 versus 4A1 with three transverse mutual intersections; certified Sage/SIROCCO braid monodromy at all four complex embeddings leaves seven equal-or-disjoint transposition assignments and no transitive degree-six action. For r=6, the unibranch incidence is one irreducible rational surface. Its ordinary-A2 locus regenerates through tame-split multibranch strata to one rational witness; its only locally admissible higher singularities are two E6 scale classes. Certified braids at the generic witness and both E6 classes again leave seven assignments and no transitive action. Hence every normal even row r=6,8,10 is impossible. The normal odd r=9 row is separately excluded by PF2D6O1; normal odd r=5,7, nonnormal terminal slices with conductor, all of (75,125), and JC(2) remain open.

OP-PLANE.title: Plane-Jacobian universal boundary and degree frontier
OP-PLANE.scope: UCBS1 proves degree-independent purity and H_Z^0 vanishing for the logarithmic cotangent cokernel, while LCDS1 places conductor mismatches in H_Z^1. PF2LNP1, PF2CLP1, PF2UCE1, LCBBC1, LCCT1, LKGD1, LTKT1, and PF2OTT1 classify the known F2 logarithmic packets and give exact cyclic root contribution 27 with zero outgoing-tail correction. PF2APF1 proves that purity requires at least one additional affine-branch boundary component, raising the squarefree/double source floors to 28/49. It bounds the geometric degrees by 6<=d<=9375 and 12<=d<=9375 and every ramified row by 2<=e<=d-1 and f<=floor((d-1)/e), but a coarse purity signature exists at every remaining d. PF2ATC1 reduces the unknown target curve to 24 normalization charts (deg p,deg q)=(3k,5k), 1<=k<=24, with projective degree 5k<=120, top implicit form P^(5k), an affine singularity, and a nonunit divided-difference collision/critical ideal. PF2K1C1 solves the first chart's collision geometry by one explicit quartic and proves that its generic target is a rational quintic with four ordinary affine nodes and a delta-2 (2,5) infinity cusp. PF2K1I1 gives its exact twelve-support implicit quintic and factors the pulled-back target gradient as the degree-eight nodal conductor times (q',-p'). PF2K1PB1 restores that quintic to fixed target coordinates, computes its carrier residue and finite eight-jet contact interface, and proves that every Keller pullback is reduced with affine singular/conductor scheme equal to the etale base change of the target singularities. PF2K1JF1 proves the target quintic is irreducible in every k=1 specialization, replaces seven normalized carrier conditions by four parameter-recovery equations plus three exact weighted compatibility equations, and separates the false C^3/s^2 origin factors from the invariant terminal leading fiber. PCJDP1 proves that the primitive (3,5) seven-jet packet ends exactly at raw-jet saturation and gives an explicit cusp-plus-three-node nonimmersion chart, but does not identify its jet ramification with a logarithmic point defect. PF2K1CC1 proves that every k=1 degeneration still has affine delta 4 and the same exact degree-eight conductor divisor, with affine Keller-pullback normalization defect at most 4*(d-1); only the finite singular-fiber counts and boundary distribution remain. PF2K1TN1 proves that every fs tame Kummer toroidal packet over a resolved target node, including the split smooth model and the collided cyclic z^e=x*y model with its full exceptional chain, is log-etale and has zero logarithmic cokernel and localized ch2. Hence target conductor length cannot be charged automatically. Its general SNC formula also proves that full-rank exponent data force zero cokernel and that a rank-one packet can have singular determinant support only after two explicit logarithmic-unit first jets vanish; failure of a toroidal chart is necessary but not sufficient for a point defect. PAER1 proves that every affine reduced-curve singularity, including the cusp-plus-three-node stratum, pulls through a Keller map by strict etale base change on embedded resolutions. Its ordinary conductor and carrier-parameter rank drop are not finite pieces of the relative logarithmic module; only compactification-boundary attachments remain. Under LUAF1's minimal transverse unibranch SNC hypotheses such a boundary point has local correction q_p*m_C and a complete residue-degree-f fiber has total correction m_C*f; q_p is distinct from the transverse divisorial index e, and those hypotheses still have to be extracted from the source. LCAD1 gives the general isolated-Fitting lower ledger m_C*f-h+c; for an ordinary cusp it ranges from f on smooth folds to 2*f on node-saturated packets. PF2PPA1 places every target puncture on the extracted (5,2) divisor with contact k. Although a formal direct terminal comparison would force lambda=125/729 and e=3, the terminal neighborhood is already resolved and every divisor extracted above it maps to one point; it supplies no affine-row slot. LCHB1 proves the degree-independent global logarithmic ch2 and boundary-blowup identities and computes provisional F2 budgets (7*d-8)/2 and (7*d-13)/2 on the current common partial model. After the exact root class 27 the degree-floor virtual residuals are -10 and 17/2. PF2K1L1 computes the generic k=1 affine divisorial contribution as e*f*(b-7)-e^2*n/2 and gives the all-signature conditional squarefree/double point formulas (e^2*n-2*e*f*(b-7)-20-s_X)/2 and (e^2*n-2*e*f*(b-7)+17-s_X)/2 with exact parity gates. On the generic cusp face, the incidence-sensitive cusp ledger tightens these effectivity bounds without changing parity. PF2K1M1 proves complement group Z on every immersed distinct-image k=1 collision partition and on the generic A_2+3*A_1 and 2*A_2+2*A_1 cusp strata. Their positive affine-sheet remainder prevents one component meridian from acting transitively, so each of these seven strata requires a second ramified affine target component and has conditional source floors 29/50; its Chern compiler must contain two affine divisorial packets. The first topological escape is E_6+A_1, whose noncyclic group has an exact transitive degree-six fixed-sheet action, so its multiplicity-three boundary packet must be combined with the global Chern budget. PF2D6E1 excludes the normal even terminal exponents r=6,8,10. PF2D6O1 proves the sharp polynomial degree-(6,10) odd gap bound 21 and excludes normal r=9; normal odd r=5,7 and nonnormal conductor slices remain. The primary global target is therefore to supply the complete fixed-coordinate F2 Laurent pair and factor its explicit quintic only at the unresolved source boundary in order to locate the required affine divisors, determine their (e,f,E^2) data, and extract the local exponent matrices and logarithmic unit derivatives. Finite affine fiber counts remain useful boundary-escape data but are not logarithmic point corrections. Only rank-one packets satisfying both first-jet equations require higher expansion; the complement/conductor calculation must still cover severe k=1 image mergers, the E_8 endpoint, and k=2..24 if k=1 is not forced. Independently, PJ43A1, PJ72Q1, RSE3, and PJ72108D1 close the audited (72,108)/(108,72) row and leave the conditional larger-coordinate frontier at 125. PF2KO1, PF2TR1, PF2GC1, PF2GA1, PF2CW1, PCW1, PF2CS1, and PF2NF1 classify substantial necessary data on the first F2 row but do not supply that global branch-curve factorization, global degree, meridian completion, complete Chern filtration, or lower-Laurent realization. Degree-specific calculations remain regression fixtures for the universal compiler; they do not exclude (75,125), improve the coordinate-degree frontier 125, or prove JC(2). PF2BATT1 imports the global plane Stein-boundary structure and excludes collided tame-node projections, while forcing every generically unramified omitted prime to have residue degree1 and an immersed image. Under the explicit single ramified-row e2,f1 hypothesis at degree6, PF2R7BND1 strengthens both classified nonimmersed normal-r7 cases: they require exactly two or three further unramified boundary primes whose immersed images differ from the cusp curve. A complete one-component nonproper locus is impossible, and the old local A5 S3 option is globally forbidden. The new required gate is to classify or exclude those additional immersed images and their infinity attachments; they have not been excluded. The immersed r7 family, normal r5 and nonnormal terminal slices remain open. Separately, the registered cusp-filtration corollary JC2CFF2 gives the necessary auxiliary contact bound delta_(2,5)(P^5+(125/729)*Q^3)>=456 in the retained F2 support envelope. A whole-polynomial upper bound<=455 would exclude that candidate, but no such upper bound is supplied. This narrows a contact gate without closing F2, r7 or JC2. JC2POS1 and JC2POS2 reproduce positivity on the actual minimal smooth resolution with a direct ruled-surface exclusion, remove the inherited cubic-scroll donor dependency, and force general target-line genus at least2. Under exactly PF2R7BND1 hypotheses, JC2POS3 forces gamma2, Picard rank8--11, four generic target-infinity decompositions with residue-degree sum2, and2--7 contracted boundary primes while retaining all2or3 unramified omitted affine primes. Boundary weights, complete projective attachment and realization remain open; no r7 class is closed.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Charging target conductor or normalization length directly as a degree-zero logarithmic boundary-point defect
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Purity kills zero-dimensional H0 in the relative logarithmic cokernel, while normalization mismatch lives in H1 and has no nonzero O-linear lift back to H0.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Using resolved affine cusp, node, or carrier-jet singularities as the missing logarithmic source correction
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: Embedded resolution commutes with the etale Keller pullback and is strict log-etale; only unresolved compactification-boundary attachments can contribute.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Assigning a positive logarithmic correction to a tame full-rank toroidal packet
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The exact monomial chart calculation gives zero logarithmic cokernel and localized second Chern term; rank-one packets survive only after two explicit unit-jet equations vanish.

forbidden_attack_classes.attack: Promoting closure of the audited (72,108) Laurent systems to the general plane degree reduction or JC(2)
forbidden_attack_classes.reason: The exact determinantal certificate closes only the two named systems; larger coordinate degrees and the global F2 boundary carrier remain open.
